subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should this PR expose active wake provenance through a new `AgentSession.steer` options shape, or should the fix be rebased into the current `userTurnTranscriptRecorder` and `ReplyBackendQueueMessageOptions` path from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90552?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not whether provenance is useful; it is the permanent API and owner-boundary shape after current main added a different queued-turn metadata seam.

options.title: Rebase onto current queue metadata seam
options.body: Resolve the conflict by preserving the current recorder-based queued transcript path and adding provenance there without introducing a competing public `steer` shape.

options.title: Accept a new steer options API
options.body: Allow the PR to add a public options-style `AgentSession.steer` surface, but require explicit compatibility review and SDK surface proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for canonical provenance design
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader active wake, spawn provenance, and Discord/ACP delivery cluster has a single maintainer-owned contract.

recommendation.title: Rebase onto current queue metadata seam
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict by preserving the current recorder-based queued transcript path and adding provenance there without introducing a competing public `steer` shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent merged work on the conflicting queued transcript context and active steering seam came from `steipete`.
